mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (measured as the month-over-month change) signals an impending monetary tightening that increases the cost of capital for corporations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen month-over-month over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) coupled with a stable or falling FEDFUNDS (monetary policy inaction) creates a negative real interest rate environment that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or falls.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1500 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS has increased month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 (index) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 110.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic growth regimes (GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), a rising GDP level (GDPC1) signals continued expansion and positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5% during strong economic growth regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL not rising) signals strong consumer demand without price pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS rises and CPIAUCSL is stable.
